description: One Italian province (two-letter code such as AQ, or its slug — a comune's `provinceCode`): population, OMI prices, foreign residents by citizenship (citizenship, not birthplace), ALL ISTAT BES well-being indicators with polarity-aware percentiles among provinces (no composite score), every province- and region-grain map layer, `seismicZones` (how many of its comuni sit in each official seismic zone — a count of comuni, never an average, since a province has no zone of its own), and how much of the province meets each verified tax regime (places, not people). Sources use different province lists — Sardinia was reorganized in 2026 — so a section a source lacks is null with a reason and listed in `missingSections`: report it as missing, never substitute another province's figure.

code.description: A province's two-letter code, e.g. "AQ", or its slug, e.g. "l-aquila". Find it in a comune's `provinceCode`.

name: get_province

foreignResidentsAllCitizenships.description: Residents holding any foreign citizenship: ISTAT's own total, not limited to the citizenships tracked in foreignResidentsByCitizenship. Citizenship, not birthplace. Summed over the comuni ISTAT has a total for: `coverage` says how many that is, and a comune with no total adds nothing rather than a zero.
